query:
WITH '<namespace_here>' as namespace
MATCH p = (n :Namespace)-[:EndpointsWithSelector]->(:EndpointSelector)<-[e *1..3]-()
WHERE n.displayname = namespace
AND type(e) IN ['Ingress', 'IngressDeny', 'FromNamespace']
OPTIONAL MATCH m = ()-[f *1..2]->(n)
WHERE type(f) IN ['Ingress', 'IngressDeny', 'FromNamespace']
RETURN p,m
LIMIT 1000
name: Cilium Namespace - Ingress
description: Full ingress graph for a specific namespace
